reviewer: Two AI reviews at the operator's request; not checked by a human. Claude Code (the AI coding assistant), 2026-10-24: every line that passed check_line and the critic. ChatGPT (a second AI model, run by the operator), 2026-10-25: the 68 Ukrainian lines shown after the first review.
scope: Every line of the v2 trace (critic in the loop) that passed check_line and the critic (218 of 232), read against its English source fact. Second review: the Ukrainian lines still shown after the first one (68 of 87).
rule: Same rule as the first (v1) review: reject a rewrite that adds a detail not in the fact, changes its meaning, overstates the data, or is not correct, idiomatic language. Tone and point of view alone are allowed. A rejected line shows its English source on the page, marked as kept. The second review applies the same rule; most of its rejections are literal calques of football phrases ('comeback', 'so close', 'chance saved'), wrong prepositions or endings, and one added detail ('підкат' for a tackle).
